name: Arcane Dark Caster
description: Recommended enhancement: Wizard. Dage has come around to gifting you with his set of shadow skills in the Arcane Dark Arts and you have become one of his legion's elite casters! (This item cannot be sold until April 6th)

description: Recommended enhancement: Hybrid. Come forth those who wish to master the beasts of the land and birds of the air, for now you have that chance!

description: Recommended enhancement: Hybrid. Come forth those who wish to master the beasts of the land and birds of the air, for now you have that chance!

name: Dark Lord
description: Recommended enhancement: Wizard. Dark Lords channel the power of the Fourth to further their goal of taking over the universe for the dark side. (And they have cookies!)

name: Dark Master of Moglins
description: [Duplicate of Master of Moglins class] Recommended enhancement: Wizard. You see a shadowy shape that resembles a Shadow Master of Moglins Class. Once the Shadow Mages finish their summon spell, you will see your class!

name: Darkside
description: Recommended enhancement: Wizard. Vader Darkside wished that the Cheezburger change into a farming based, pet class and thus the Darkside Class was born!

name: Dragonlord (Class)
description: Recommended enhancements: Lucky. Armed with the might, wisdom, and cunning of ancient dragons, the DragonLord charges into battle with their bonded dragon at their side. Those worthy of greater power can evolve and unleash their elemental draconic magic to devastate the battlefield.

name: Grim Necromancer (Class)
description: When one ascends beyond the mere raising of bones, then one can be called Grim.

description: The Hollowborn Judge remains in a state of frailty caused by past trauma and her rebirth as a Hollowborn. She represents the highest virtues of Justice.
